Israel Flies Warplanes Near Iran Border Despite US Hesitation

Dozens of Israeli fighter jets flew near the Iranian border, a show of military strength intended to deter Iran from an attack. The action, however, raised concerns about a potential Iranian counter-response and the risk of renewed conflict. This occurred despite apparent hesitation from the US, with reports suggesting former President Trump applied an "emergency brake" on Israeli plans to strike Iran.
